description: This PHP source file defines the `SupervisorEvaluationAPI` class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing supervisor evaluations within the performance review system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and controlling access to supervisor review data, along with associated validation rules and internal helper functions. The class integrates with the HRM system's core API framework, uses traits for functionality, and manages workflow states, permissions, and review ratings.

classes.name: SupervisorEvaluationAPI
classes.description: This class extends the Endpoint class and implements the CrudEndpoint interface to provide API operations (GET, PUT) for supervisor evaluations in performance reviews. It manages retrieval and update of review ratings, navigates workflow states, enforces access control, and provides validation rules.
